answer: Stake the reviewer: 50 POA behind each verdict, spot-check one in ten against a second panel, and void the batch when the panel's funding overlaps. Example: five reviewers from one inlet of wallets all lose their stakes, costing 250 POA and their standing. Skeptical read: spot checks only catch what the second panel sees, and a patient farm can pass nine of ten. The dune of cheap verdicts still dries up the nectar.
